title.zh: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years
title.en: BitMEX shuts down: perpetuals pioneer officially closes it doors after 11 years

current_state.zh: BitMEX, the perpetual-swap pioneer co-founded by Arthur Hayes, officially shut down trading and deposits after 11 years, keeping logins and withdrawals open as its wind-down continues.
